name: Eleazar (son of Annas)
title: High Priest, son of Annas
summary: Eleazar was one of the high priest Annas' sons who himself served as high priest. He belonged to the powerful priestly family that dominated the temple during the time of Jesus and the apostles.

keyEvents.title: From the high priestly lineage
keyEvents.description: Eleazar belonged to Annas' family, which formed the core of the high priestly family mentioned in Acts.
